entry.summary: West to northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Watch period extended until Sunday evening.

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale west to northwest winds gusting 120 km/h in exposed places. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Warning period extended.

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale west to southwesterlies gusting 120 km/h in exposed places. Note, after the warning period ends, westerlies are expected to be gale force at times in exposed places through Monday. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale westerlies gusting 120 km/h in exposed places, especially south of Gore/Secretary Island. Note, after the warning period ends, westerlies are expected to be gale force at times in exposed places through Monday. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.
